propositions: On fresh upgrade (store file absent), backfill must populate confirmation records for all managed refs with bound targets, marked with source=backfill and direction=backfill, so the first post-upgrade pass does not decline legitimate peer deletions
Backfill must not run on an existing but empty store file; it only runs when was_absent=true to avoid silent re-population after legitimate operator-initiated emptying

The evidence step must use a single store instance opened once: backfill runs first, then snapshot confirmation on the same instance, then single save, so backfilled records are visible to and can be overwritten by snapshot confirmation in the same pass
Backfill must not downgrade provenance: it skips any key already carrying a push or snapshot record, while later snapshot confirmation overwrites backfilled entries by unconditional record() behavior
Backfilled records are treated as confirmed by is_confirmed(), preserving the grandfathering intent without reopening the blind spot at decision points
Managed refs with unbound targets receive no backfill record; backfill runs once per store lifetime (file absent at open) and adds zero records on subsequent passes
